name: video-studio
description: Make AI videos from idea to MP4: scenario writes a director-style brief, setup scaffolds the project (ClaudeAnimationBase, HyperFrames or hybrid), create directs, animates, reviews and renders it scene by scene. Music optional.

interface.longDescription: Three skills for making AI videos with a coding agent. scenario turns an idea (and an optional song) into a long, director-style brief in the Claude Pop / P(doom) style and picks the engine: p5.brush hand-painted animation, HyperFrames HTML/GSAP motion graphics, or both. setup scaffolds the project folder and runs a preflight check. create builds the timeline and storyboard, sets the quality bar on the first scenes, works scene by scene with contact-sheet review, and renders the MP4 plus cutdowns.
defaultPrompt: Write a video brief for a 60-second launch video of my app
Set up the video project for this brief
